name: Nexus USD
oneLiner: NUSD is a legacy Synapse bridge-liquidity stable asset backed by a DAI/USDC/USDT pool, with the dollar peg inherited from the underlying basket.
collateral: Synapse stable-swap pool assets backed by DAI, USDC, and USDT liquidity across supported bridge deployments
pegMechanism: Bridge-liquidity stable asset minted and redeemed through Synapse pool routes, with the dollar peg inherited from the underlying stablecoin basket and pool arbitrage

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: NUSD inherits upstream freeze exposure because the modeled reserve basket references DAI, USDC, and USDT stablecoin liquidity.

notices.title: Legacy bridge-liquidity asset
notices.message: NUSD is included because DefiLlama still returns a live price and circulating supply, but it represents a legacy Synapse bridge liquidity stable asset rather than a standalone modern issuer token. The canonical Ethereum contract is included for symbol disambiguation; legacy per-chain bridge deployments are not exhaustively modeled.

mintAuthority.summary: NUSD is Synapse's cross-chain synthetic dollar: it is minted/burned by the Synapse bridge against the DAI/USDC/USDT nexus pool on Ethereum, so supply is created by bridge-controlled mint on each chain rather than by user collateral deposits.

controls.label: Synapse bridge mint authority
controls.evidence: Synapse routes bridge transfers by minting/burning the nUSD synthetic asset: assets enter the Ethereum nexus stableswap pool, nUSD is locked/burned on the source chain and minted on the destination chain by the bridge contracts. Mint authority is held by the Synapse bridge/router system, not by depositing users.

review.evidence: DefiLlama and Synapse/L2BEAT coverage describe nUSD as a lock-mint bridge synthetic backed by the Ethereum nexus pool (DAI/USDC/USDT); supply on each chain is created by the Synapse bridge mint route. This is a bridge-or-oft-synthetic path under a concentrated bridge admin; this is a legacy asset and the live signer set was not independently resolved.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Mechanism resolved from DefiLlama/L2BEAT coverage of Synapse's nUSD lock-mint bridge model; the on-chain bridge mint admin/multisig for this legacy asset was not independently confirmed.
unresolvedQuestions: Confirm the current Synapse bridge contract that holds nUSD mint authority and whether its admin is an active multisig or has been retired.
